_help: The game's own fonts (UI kit 0.16.0). Files live in public/fonts/<folder>/ with their licence / readme. name = the font's name in style.json; licence = commercial-ok 🟢 · credit-needed 🟡 · non-commercial 🔴 · unknown 🔴; pixelSize = a pixel font's native size (crisp at it and its whole multiples). samples = the lines the Dev Kit's Fonts tab tries each role with.
